title: A first person rhythm game where smashing blocks on-beat earns musical coin projectiles
author: Donkeytonk
selftext:
This is my vibe jam game entry [Sounds Smashing!](http://soundssmashing.com/) It's a browser rhythm game where you smash blocks on beat to earn coins, then fire those coins as musical projectiles to the rhythm to get even more coins and cause some physics based destruction while you're at it.

It’s first-person, runs in browsers and I made 10 levels so far. All actions, smashes, coins, rubble etc add to the musical layers so every play feels like you're making a unique jam as you go.

The music is synthesized on the fly and procedural with sections that change chord progression, drums, and lead motifs. No assets. No models. No audio files. The whole thing weighs 2.9 MB on disk.

Built with Three.js + Rapier3D (for physics) using Claude. 

Discord: [https://discord.gg/YvSxxrD7jj](https://discord.gg/YvSxxrD7jj)

comments.author: AntiqueFeedback7447
comments.body: Super unique idea! Never seen a rhythm based destruction game before ✨

replies.author: Donkeytonk
replies.body: It started it out as a just a normal physics based destruction game with different materials. I tried to make the smashes more satisfying  by aligning them to the scale of the track. At some point I realized I'd accidentally created a destruction rhythm game!
